title: Rubrik Joins Internet2 to Advance Cyber Resilience and AI Operations in Higher Education
summary: Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, today announced its membership in Internet2, a member-based organization that empowers the education and research community with network, cloud and security solutions. The strategic collaboration deepens Rubrik’s engagement with colleges, universities, and research institutions, supporting data backup and cyber recovery to ensure their mission-critical services are available to students, staff, faculty and administrators. Educational institutions are foundational pillars of communities throughout the U.S., yet they are increasingly vulnerable to malicious cyber activity. A recent analysis reveals that 82% of U.S. educational organizations reported cyber threat impacts. As an Internet2 industry member, Rubrik is joining a network of more than 500 member organizations that share knowledge and research to help protect and recover from cyber attacks.
